origins.section: Role Interfaces Turn the Refusal into a Compile Error
A Method Added to a Fat Interface Breaks Classes That Never Call It
A Default Method Keeps Implementations Compiling, and Runs Code That Never Saw Their Locks
Collection Is Fat on Purpose, and Java 21's SequencedCollection Repeats It

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-split-report-store: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-split-report-store: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-split-report-store: Role Interfaces Turn the Refusal into a Compile Error: 'Split the interface by what its clients do with it. Reading is one role, writing another, and a client that needs both names a type that extends both', with ListingReader / ListingWriter / ListingStore extends both, ReplicaStore implements ListingReader, the sweeper takes ListingStore and the wiring mistake becomes 'incompatible types'. Option a has the same shape. Partly true: the importer calls only save but would see purge through ReportWriter. The page does the same (ListingWriter holds save and delete) and does not discuss it, so this is consistent with the page.
recorded.prompt:q-added-method: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-added-method: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-added-method: A Method Added to a Fat Interface Breaks Classes That Never Call It: adding exportAll() to ListingStore gives 'FakeStore is not abstract and does not override abstract method exportAll() in ListingStore' for 'The test fake for SearchPage, in src/test'. Also: 'the search page's fake [gets] a fourth empty method' though 'Neither the replica nor the search page exports anything'. Summary: 'breaks classes that never call it, test fakes included'.
recorded.prompt:q-inherited-removeif: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-inherited-removeif: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-inherited-removeif: A Default Method Keeps Implementations Compiling...: removeIf is 'a default method that iterates with iterator() and removes through it'. 'The inherited removeIf iterated without the bag's lock, so the add landed in the middle.' Reference: Collection.removeIf (default) 'iterates with iterator(), removes with Iterator.remove(); takes no lock'. LockedBag has the same shape as GuardedQueue.
recorded.prompt:q-sequenced-addlast: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-sequenced-addlast: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-sequenced-addlast: Collection Is Fat on Purpose...: SequencedCollection's 'defaults for addFirst and addLast throw'. 'javac accepted all four calls... the playlist refuses them at run time'. Reference: 'SequencedCollection.addFirst, addLast (default) | always throw UnsupportedOperationException'. The Playlist demo calls addFirst rather than addLast; the reference row and the prose cover addLast.

recorded.prompt:q-split-report-store:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-split-report-store:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-split-report-store:b: Split by Client, Not by Method: 'A role is the set of methods one kind of client uses together. Split further, and the clients pay instead... the sweeper needs an intersection type'. The retention job uses list and purge together, so splitting purge off forces two roles on it. Summary: 'one interface per method makes clients carry intersection types'.

recorded.pass:q-split-report-store:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-split-report-store:c: Same subsection: 'With one interface per method, the sweeper needs an intersection type and three fields that all hold the same object' and 'this split buys nothing over two roles'.
recorded.prompt:q-split-report-store:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-split-report-store:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-split-report-store:d: Refuted only by implication. The page never discusses an isWritable() flag. A Fat Interface Compiles Calls...: 'The compiler checks that ReplicaStore has a delete, not what it does', and the stub turns a wiring mistake into a run-time failure. Under d the archive still implements the fat interface and its stubs.

recorded.prompt:q-inherited-removeif:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-inherited-removeif:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-inherited-removeif:a: Reference: Collection.removeIf 'iterates with iterator(), removes with Iterator.remove(); takes no lock'. The LockedBag row ('other thread's add ran during removeIf: true') shows it does not run under the lock. The page does not mention size(), so the specific reason in a is refuted only through 'takes no lock'.
recorded.prompt:q-inherited-removeif:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-inherited-removeif:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-inherited-removeif:b: Same section: LockedBag's add, remove and size are synchronized, yet 'The inherited removeIf iterated without the bag's lock'. Only LockedBag2, which overrides removeIf as synchronized, holds the lock. The page shows this rule through the demo; it does not state it.
recorded.prompt:q-inherited-removeif:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-inherited-removeif:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-inherited-removeif:d: Same section: 'Java 8 added removeIf to Collection as a default method that iterates with iterator() and removes through it, so ordinary implementations kept compiling.' The throwing defaults belong to SequencedCollection.addFirst, not removeIf.
